name: GL_SEGMENT_VALUES_INTERFACE
description: This interface table is used to import segment values into Fusion.

columns.name: SEGMENT_VALUE_INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: Interface table record identifier.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Segment value status code. Use value: NEW. Automatically updated by import job as needed with values from lookup type GL_SEG_VALUE_ERROR_CODES.

columns.name: VALUE_SET_CODE
columns.description: Value set code.  Use the Manage Charts of Accounts Value Sets task to find valid values.  Foreign key to fnd_vs_value_sets

columns.name: VALUE
columns.description: Value set value. Validation: must conform to the value set validation and data type.

columns.name: START_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.description: Date from when the segment value is valid. Date format: YYYY/MM/DD.

columns.name: END_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.description: Date until when segment value is valid. May not be earlier than START_ACTIVE_DATE. Date format: YYYY/MM/DD.

columns.name: SUMMARY_FLAG
columns.description: Confirms whether the segment is a child or parent. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Confirms whether the segment value is enabled. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_TYPE
columns.description: Segment value account type. Valid values: A , C, D, L, E, O, R. Meanings: A is Asset, C is Budgetary Credit, D is Budgetary Debit, L is liability, E is expense, O is Owners'' Equity, R is Revenue.

columns.name: ALLOW_POSTING_FLAG
columns.description: Posting is allowed for the segment value. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: ALLOW_BUDGETING_FLAG
columns.description: Budgeting is allowed for the segment value. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: THIRD_PARTY_CTRL_ACCOUNT
columns.description: Third party control account. Valid values: CUSTOMER, SUPPLIER, R, Y, N. Meanings: CUSTOMER restricts use to Receivables. SUPPLIER restricts use to Payables. R restricts to use by subledgers only, no manual journals may use the account. Y indicates it is a control account for any third party type.

columns.name: RECONCILE_FLAG
columns.description: Segment value is marked for reconciliation. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: FINANCIAL_CATEGORY
columns.description: Financial category of the segment. Use the Manage General Ledger Lookup Values task, lookup type FINANCIAL_CATEGORY, to identify valid values.

columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is increased every time the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
